# teams_work_location_detection_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing WorkLocationDetectionPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `enable_work_location_detection` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableWorkLocationDetection parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `user_settings_default` (String) Maps to the -UserSettingsDefault parameter.
